hooks.name: Guard: demo data never reaches real routes
hooks.description: Static check that only app/api/demo/route.ts imports the simulated snapshot, and that it labels responses as simulated. Fails loudly naming the offending file.

action.command: cd "$(dirname "$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name vitest.config.ts -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -print -quit)")" && npx vitest run tests/data/demo-isolation.test.ts
